req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 400 error when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body. This ensures data consistency and prevents ambiguous updates. The test suite will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_put_player_id_match
preconditions: A player with squad_number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with a matching squad_number in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Ensure player with squad_number 10 exists
player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Action: Send PUT request with matching squad_number
response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)

# Expected: Status code 204
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_player_id_mismatch
preconditions: A player with squad_number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with a different squad_number in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Ensure player with squad_number 10 exists
player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Action: Send PUT request with mismatched squad_number
mismatched_data = player_data.copy()
mismatched_data["squadNumber"] = 11
response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=mismatched_data)

# Expected: Status code 400
assert response.status_code == 400
